name: pgdiff
description: Diff two live PostgreSQL schemas and emit reversible up/down migrations.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pgdiff/cli && npm run build -w @pgdiff/server && npm run build -w @pgdiff/web
scripts.dev: node scripts/run-parallel.mjs "npm run dev -w @pgdiff/server" "npm run dev -w @pgdiff/web"
scripts.prestart: npm run build -w @pgdiff/server && npm run build -w @pgdiff/web
